prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ENV02 FLOOR, one independently painted transparent layer for a mobile storybook garden-kitchen puzzle game. Full LANDSCAPE 1536 by 1024 canvas.
Primary request: Broad sunlit terracotta courtyard paving viewed from a gentle elevated three-quarter angle. Large worn warm apricot clay tiles with softly rounded octagonal outlines and very small cream diamond insets, subtle handpainted mortar, faint lavender shadows along seams. Calm low-contrast warm tile field for small colorful gameplay props, with just a few tiny sage moss flecks at the far outer edges.
Style: original polished gouache children's adventure book, broad textured paper brushwork, simplified soft handmade shapes, warm cream daylight, no photorealism. A different surface from pale harbor limestone: this is an outdoor cooking terrace.
Composition: Entire upper35percent is truly transparent. From a roughly horizontal boundary around35percent down, paving extends continuously across full canvas width to the bottom edge. Ground plane is uninterrupted and level, no obstacle or raised step in the action area. Preserve the full transparent upper margin and1536×1024canvas.
Constraints: ONLY ground. No kitchen furniture, no stove, no oven, no fire, no smoke, no bowl, no water or pool, no buildings, no parapet, no near plants, no food, no cooking tools, no characters. Actual gameplay pools will be composited above this ground using exact authored geometry. No lettering, no UI, no watermark. Genuine alpha above the floor, not a colored rectangular background.
